/* Reset checkbox */
.ui.checkbox {

.ui.checkbox label {

}

.ui.checkbox label:before,
.ui.checkbox label:after {

<p>
<h4>PETUNJUK:</h4>
<ol>
<li>Silahkan mengerjakan Latihan CAT Akademik POLRI<strong> </strong>berikut dengan sungguh-sungguh;</li>
<li>Anggap sedang mengerjakan ujian sebenarnya, karena pola latihan ini dibuat sama dengan ujian CAT sebenarnya;</li>
<li>Kerjakan soal yang mudah terlebih dahulu;</li>
<li>Lihat hasil kerja di akhir latihan dan lakukan evaluasi;</li>
<li>Lakukan pengulangan latihan, soal latihan akan di acak dan diperbaharui dengan soal berbeda;</li>
<li>Nilai kelulusan latihan dengan passing grade memenuhi syarat (MS) dengan batas lulus minimal 61;</li>
<li>Jumlah soal: 50 soal – Waktu pengerjaan: 3.600 detik (60 menit)</li>
<li> Penilaian di latihan ini menggunakan skala 5 dengan skor maksimal 500 poin:
<ul>
<li>Menjawab Benar 5 Poin</li>
<li>Menjawab Salah 0 Poin</li>
<li>Tidak Menjawab 0 Poin</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Selamat Belajar !</li>
</ol>
</p>

<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Di suatu kandang terdapat 50 ekor ayam, 18 diantaranya jantan. Di antara ayam jantan tersebut, 7 ekor berwarna putih. Jika banyak ayam berwarna putih adalah 22 ekor, maka banyak ayam betina yang tidak berwarna putih adalah &#8230; ekor</p>
</div>
<ul class="wpProQuiz_questionList" data-question_id="28830"

</li>

<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">

Benar </span><br>
<p>Terdapat 50 ekor ayam, 18 diantaranya jantan, maka 32 ekor lainnya adalah betina. Ada 7 ekor ayam jantan berwarna putih dari 22 ekor ayam seluruhnya yang berwarna putih, maka:<br />
ayam betina berwarna putih=22-7= 15 ekor. Sehingga ayam betina yang tidak berwarna putih = 32-15= 17 ekor.</p> </div>

<h5 style="display: inline-block;"

<span>12</span>. Pertanyaan </h5>

<span style="font-weight: bold; float: right;">2 poin</span>
<div style="clear: both;"></div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Pembangunan sebuah gedung direncanakan akan selesai dalam waktu 22 hari oleh 24 orang pekerja. Setelah dikerjakan selama 10 hari, pekerjaan dihentikan 4 hari karena ada sesuatu hal. Jika kemampuan bekerja setiap orang sama dan agar pembangunan selesai sesuai tepat waktu, maka banyak pekerja tambahan yang dibutuhkan adalah &#8230;</p>
</div>
<ul class="wpProQuiz_questionList" data-question_id="28831"
data-type="single">
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="0">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28831"
value="1"> 6 orang </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="1">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28831"
value="2"> 8 orang </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="2">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28831"
value="3"> 10 orang </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="3">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28831"
value="4"> 12 orang </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="4">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28831"
value="5"> 36 orang </label>

</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_correct">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Benar </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<p>Dik:</p>
<ul data-start="77" data-end="176">
<li data-start="77" data-end="111">
<p data-start="79" data-end="111">24 pekerja → 22 hari → selesai</p>
</li>
<li data-start="112" data-end="176">
<p data-start="114" data-end="176">Sudah bekerja 10 hari, terhenti 4 hari → sisa waktu = 8 hariLangkah &#8211; langkah:</p>
</li>
</ul>
<ol data-start="204" data-end="457">
<li data-start="204" data-end="247">
<p data-start="207" data-end="247">Total kerja = 24 × 22 = 528 orang–hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="248" data-end="337">
<p data-start="251" data-end="337">Sudah dikerjakan = 24 × 10 = 240 orang–hari<br data-start="294" data-end="297" />→ Sisa = 528 − 240 = 288 orang–hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="338" data-end="414">
<p data-start="341" data-end="414">Agar selesai dalam 8 hari: pekerja yang dibutuhkan = 288 ÷ 8 = 36 orang</p>
</li>
<li data-start="415" data-end="457">
<p data-start="418" data-end="457">Tambahan pekerja = 36 − 24 = 12 orang</p>
</li>
</ol> </div>
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_incorrect">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Salah </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<p>Dik:</p>
<ul data-start="77" data-end="176">
<li data-start="77" data-end="111">
<p data-start="79" data-end="111">24 pekerja → 22 hari → selesai</p>
</li>
<li data-start="112" data-end="176">
<p data-start="114" data-end="176">Sudah bekerja 10 hari, terhenti 4 hari → sisa waktu = 8 hariLangkah &#8211; langkah:</p>
</li>
</ul>
<ol data-start="204" data-end="457">
<li data-start="204" data-end="247">
<p data-start="207" data-end="247">Total kerja = 24 × 22 = 528 orang–hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="248" data-end="337">
<p data-start="251" data-end="337">Sudah dikerjakan = 24 × 10 = 240 orang–hari<br data-start="294" data-end="297" />→ Sisa = 528 − 240 = 288 orang–hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="338" data-end="414">
<p data-start="341" data-end="414">Agar selesai dalam 8 hari: pekerja yang dibutuhkan = 288 ÷ 8 = 36 orang</p>
</li>
<li data-start="415" data-end="457">
<p data-start="418" data-end="457">Tambahan pekerja = 36 − 24 = 12 orang</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>

<h5 style="display: inline-block;"

<span>14</span>. Pertanyaan </h5>

<span style="font-weight: bold; float: right;">2 poin</span>
<div style="clear: both;"></div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Enam orang anak akan naik mobil dengan kapasitas delapan tempat duduk, yakni dua di depan termasuk sopir, tiga di tengah, dan tiga di baris belakang. Jika dari enam orang tersebut hanya ada dua orang yang bisa mengemudi, maka banyaknya cara mengatur tempat duduk mereka adalah &#8230;</p>
</div>
<ul class="wpProQuiz_questionList" data-question_id="28833"
data-type="single">
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="0">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28833"
value="1"> 840 </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="1">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28833"
value="2"> 1.400 </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="2">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28833"
value="3"> 1.540 </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="3">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28833"
value="4"> 1.680 </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="4">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28833"
value="5"> 1.960 </label>

</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_correct">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Benar </span><br>
<p><ul>
<li>Banyak cara susunan sopir = 2</li>
<li>Banyak cara tempat duduk penumpang (5 penumpang) dapat dihitung dengan kaidah perkalian: 5x4x3x2x1= 120</li>
<li>Banyak cara untuk memilih tempat duduk (ada 7 tempat duduk penumpang) = 7 cara</li>
</ul>
<p>Sehingga, banyak cara seluruhnya adalah: 2x120x7= 1.680 cara</p></p> </div>
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_incorrect">

<li>Banyak cara untuk memilih tempat duduk (ada 7 tempat duduk penumpang) = 7 cara</li>
</ul>
<p>Sehingga, banyak cara seluruhnya adalah: 2x120x7= 1.680 cara</p>
</p> </div>
</div>

<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Seseorang ingin mengiklankan mobilnya melalui surat kabar dalam 3 baris. Pada hari pertama ia harus membayar  Rp30.000,00 per baris, untuk 3 hari berikutnya Rp20.000,00 per baris per hari dan hari-hari selanjutnya Rp15.000,00 per baris. Berapa ia bisa memasang iklan di surat kabar tersebut jika ia membayar Rp360.000,00?</p>
</div>
<ul class="wpProQuiz_questionList" data-question_id="28834"

value="5"> 10 hari </label>

</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_correct">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Benar </span><br>
<p><h3 data-start="75" data-end="89">Pembahasan :</h3>
<ul data-start="90" data-end="333">
<li data-start="90" data-end="115">
<p data-start="92" data-end="115">Baris iklan = 3 baris</p>
</li>
<li data-start="116" data-end="308">
<p data-start="118" data-end="126">Biaya:</p>
<ul data-start="129" data-end="308">
<li data-start="129" data-end="175">
<p data-start="131" data-end="175">Hari 1: 30.000/baris → 3 × 30.000 = 90.000</p>
</li>
<li data-start="178" data-end="235">
<p data-start="180" data-end="235">Hari 2–4: 20.000/baris → 3 × 20.000 = 60.000 per hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="238" data-end="308">
<p data-start="240" data-end="308">Hari 5 dan seterusnya: 15.000/baris → 3 × 15.000 = 45.000 per hari</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li data-start="309" data-end="333">
<p data-start="311" data-end="333">Total uang = 360.000</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="340" data-end="382">Langkah 1: Kurangi biaya hari per hari</h3>
<ol data-start="383" data-end="612">
<li data-start="383" data-end="422">
<p data-start="386" data-end="422">Hari 1: 360.000 − 90.000 = 270.000</p>
</li>
<li data-start="423" data-end="462">
<p data-start="426" data-end="462">Hari 2: 270.000 − 60.000 = 210.000</p>
</li>
<li data-start="463" data-end="502">
<p data-start="466" data-end="502">Hari 3: 210.000 − 60.000 = 150.000</p>
</li>
<li data-start="503" data-end="541">
<p data-start="506" data-end="541">Hari 4: 150.000 − 60.000 = 90.000</p>
</li>
<li data-start="542" data-end="579">
<p data-start="545" data-end="579">Hari 5: 90.000 − 45.000 = 45.000</p>
</li>
<li data-start="580" data-end="612">
<p data-start="583" data-end="612">Hari 6: 45.000 − 45.000 = 0</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="614" data-end="641">Total hari = <strong data-start="629" data-end="639">6 hari<br />
Hitung sisa uang setiap hari sampai habis; jangan lupa hari-hari setelah hari ke-4 biaya turun menjadi 45.000/hari.<br />
</strong></p></p> </div>

<h5 style="display: inline-block;"

<span>16</span>. Pertanyaan </h5>

<span style="font-weight: bold; float: right;">2 poin</span>
<div style="clear: both;"></div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Suatu Kelompok belajar yang terdiri dari 10 orang membentuk dua kelompok berbeda yang anggotanya masing-masing sama banyak. Rata-rata berat badan kelompok pertama 45,8 kg dan rata-rata kelompok dua 47,6 kg. Karena menginginkan rata-rata berat badan dari dua kelompok tersebut sama maka Ani pada kelompok pertama dan Anton pada kelompok kedua saling bertukar kelompok dan rata-rata berat badannya menjadi sama. Berapa selisih berat badan Ani dan Anton?</p>
</div>
<ul class="wpProQuiz_questionList" data-question_id="28835"
data-type="single">
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="0">

<span style="display:none;"></span>

<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="1">

<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28835"
value="2"> 6,3 kg </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="2">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28835"
value="3"> 5,2 kg </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="4">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28835"
value="5"> 1,8 kg </label>

</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_correct">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Benar </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :<br />
Selisih total berat kedua kelompok awal adalah 238 − 229 = 9 kg. Agar rata-rata sama setelah bertukar satu orang dari tiap kelompok, selisih individu harus <strong data-start="943" data-end="969">setengah selisih total</strong>, yaitu 9 ÷ 2 = 4,5 kg.</p> </div>
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_incorrect">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">

<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Pada sebuah kompetisi sepakbola, setiap tim bertanding melawan tim lain masing-masing satu kali. Jika kompetisi itu diikuti oleh 16 tim, maka banyak pertandingan yang mungkin terjadi adalah &#8230;</p>
</div>
<ul class="wpProQuiz_questionList" data-question_id="28836"
data-type="single">
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="0">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28836"
value="1"> 160 </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="1">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28836"
value="2"> 150 </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="2">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28836"
value="3"> 120 </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="3">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28836"
value="4"> 110 </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="4">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28836"
value="5"> 115 </label>

</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_correct">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Benar </span><br>
<p>Terdapat 16 tim yang mengikuti kompetisi dengan cara bertanding dengan setiap tim masing-masing saku kali. Sehingga,</p>
<p>Tim pertama bertanding dengan 15 tim lain = 15 kali pertandingan.</p>
<p>Tim Kedua bertandingan lagi dengan 14 tim lain (karena sudah bertanding dengan tim pertama) = 14 kali pertandingan</p>
<p>Tim Ketiga bertandingan lagi dengan 13 tim lain (karena sudah bertanding dengan tim pertama dan kedua) = 13 kali pertandingan.</p>
<p>Begitu seterusnya hingga tim kelima belas bertanding melawan tim keenam belas = 1 pertandingan.</p>
<p>Jika dituliskan banyak seluruh pertandingannya adalah: 15+14+13+ &#8230;. +3+2+1= 120 pertandingan</p> </div>
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_incorrect">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Salah </span><br>
<p>Terdapat 16 tim yang mengikuti kompetisi dengan cara bertanding dengan setiap tim masing-masing saku kali. Sehingga,</p>
<p>Tim pertama bertanding dengan 15 tim lain = 15 kali pertandingan.</p>
<p>Tim Kedua bertandingan lagi dengan 14 tim lain (karena sudah bertanding dengan tim pertama) = 14 kali pertandingan</p>
<p>Tim Ketiga bertandingan lagi dengan 13 tim lain (karena sudah bertanding dengan tim pertama dan kedua) = 13 kali pertandingan.</p>
<p>Begitu seterusnya hingga tim kelima belas bertanding melawan tim keenam belas = 1 pertandingan.</p>
<p>Jika dituliskan banyak seluruh pertandingannya adalah: 15+14+13+ &#8230;. +3+2+1= 120 pertandingan</p>
</div>
</div>

<p>Panitia mengedarkan undangan pertemuan untuk 50 wanita dan 70 pria. Jika ternyata 40% dari undangan wanita dan 50% undangan pria hadir, maka presentase banyak kehadiran seluruhnya adalah &#8230;</p>

<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_correct">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Benar </span><br>
<p><strong>Pembahasan : </strong></p>
<ul data-start="83" data-end="208">
<li data-start="83" data-end="146">
<p data-start="85" data-end="146">Wanita diundang = 50 orang, hadir 40% → 50 × 0,4 = 20 orang</p>
</li>
<li data-start="147" data-end="208">
<p data-start="149" data-end="208">Pria diundang = 70 orang, hadir 50% → 70 × 0,5 = 35 orang</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="215" data-end="246">Langkah 1: Total yang hadir</h3>
<h3 data-start="215" data-end="246"><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mn></mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">20 + 35 = 55 \text{ orang hadir}</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord">20 </span><span class="mbin">+ </span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">35 </span><span class="mrel">= </span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">55</span><span class="mord text"><span class="mord"> orang hadir</span></span></span></span></span></span></h3>
<h3 data-start="289" data-end="318">Langkah 2: Total undangan</h3>
<h3 data-start="289" data-end="318"><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mn></mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">50 + 70 = 120 \text{ orang}</annotation></semantics></math></span><strong><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord">50 </span><span class="mbin">+ </span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">70 </span><span class="mrel">= </span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">120</span><span class="mord text"><span class="mord"> orang</span></span></span></span></strong></span></span></h3>
<h3 data-start="356" data-end="391">Langkah 3: Persentase kehadiran</h3>
<p data-start="85" data-end="146"><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>55</mn><mn>120</mn></mfrac><mo>×</mo><mn>100</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>45</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>83</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>45</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>8</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">% = DIBULATKAN 46</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{55}{120} \times 100\% = 45,83\% \approx 45,8\%</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></span></p> </div>
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_incorrect">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Salah </span><br>
<p><strong>Pembahasan : </strong></p>
<ul data-start="83" data-end="208">
<li data-start="83" data-end="146">
<p data-start="85" data-end="146">Wanita diundang = 50 orang, hadir 40% → 50 × 0,4 = 20 orang</p>
</li>
<li data-start="147" data-end="208">
<p data-start="149" data-end="208">Pria diundang = 70 orang, hadir 50% → 70 × 0,5 = 35 orang</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="215" data-end="246">Langkah 1: Total yang hadir</h3>
<h3 data-start="215" data-end="246"><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mn></mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">20 + 35 = 55 \text{ orang hadir}</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord">20 </span><span class="mbin">+ </span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">35 </span><span class="mrel">= </span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">55</span><span class="mord text"><span class="mord"> orang hadir</span></span></span></span></span></span></h3>
<h3 data-start="289" data-end="318">Langkah 2: Total undangan</h3>
<h3 data-start="289" data-end="318"><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mn></mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">50 + 70 = 120 \text{ orang}</annotation></semantics></math></span><strong><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord">50 </span><span class="mbin">+ </span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">70 </span><span class="mrel">= </span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">120</span><span class="mord text"><span class="mord"> orang</span></span></span></span></strong></span></span></h3>
<h3 data-start="356" data-end="391">Langkah 3: Persentase kehadiran</h3>
<p data-start="85" data-end="146"><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>55</mn><mn>120</mn></mfrac><mo>×</mo><mn>100</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>45</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>83</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi><mo>≈</mo><mn>45</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>8</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">% = DIBULATKAN 46</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{55}{120} \times 100\% = 45,83\% \approx 45,8\%</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>

<h5 style="display: inline-block;"

<span style="font-weight: bold; float: right;">2 poin</span>
<div style="clear: both;"></div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Jika suatu persegi panjang ukuran panjangnya ditambah 20% dan ukuran lebarnya dikurangi 20%, maka perubahan luas persegi panjang tersebut adalah ….</p>
</div>
<ul class="wpProQuiz_questionList" data-question_id="28840"
data-type="single">
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="0">

<span style="display:none;"></span>

<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="1">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28840"
value="2"> Berkurang 4% </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="2">

<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">

<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">

<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<p data-start="64" data-end="76">Diketahui:</p>
<ul data-start="77" data-end="267">
<li data-start="77" data-end="121">
<p data-start="79" data-end="121">Panjang awal = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>
</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord mathnormal">p</span></span></span></span>, lebar awal = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>
</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">l</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord mathnormal">l</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="122" data-end="158">
<p data-start="124" data-end="158">Luas awal = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mi>p</mi><mo>×</mo><mi>l</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">L_1 = p \times l</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="160" data-end="214">
<p data-start="162" data-end="214">Panjang baru = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>p</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>20</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi><mtext> dari </mtext><mi>p</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>p</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p + 20\% \text{ dari } p = 1,2p</annotation></semantics></math></span> </span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="215" data-end="267">
<p data-start="217" data-end="267">Lebar baru = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>l</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>20</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi><mtext> dari </mtext><mi>l</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>l</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">l &#8211; 20\% \text{ dari } l = 0,8l</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="269" data-end="281">Luas baru:</p>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mtext>panjang baru</mtext><mo>×</mo><mtext>lebar baru</mtext><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>p</mi><mo>×</mo><mn>0</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>l</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>96</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi>p</mi><mi>l</mi></mrow></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>
<p data-start="375" data-end="392">Perubahan luas:</p>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mtext>Perubahan</mtext><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>96</mn><mi>p</mi><mi>l</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>p</mi><mi>l</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>04</mn><mi>p</mi><mi>l</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\text{Perubahan} = L_2 &#8211; L_1 = 0,96pl &#8211; pl = -0,04pl</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></span></p>
<p data-start="455" data-end="472">Ubah ke persen:</p>

<p data-start="521" data-end="557"><strong data-start="521" data-end="536">Kesimpulan:</strong> Luas berkurang 4%.</p> </div>

</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">p</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord mathnormal">p</span></span></span></span>, lebar awal = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>

</li>

</span></p>

</li>
<li data-start="215" data-end="267">
<p data-start="217" data-end="267">Lebar baru = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>l</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>20</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">%</mi><mtext> dari </mtext><mi>l</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>l</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">l &#8211; 20\% \text{ dari } l = 0,8l</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="269" data-end="281">Luas baru:</p>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mtext>panjang baru</mtext><mo>×</mo><mtext>lebar baru</mtext><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>p</mi><mo>×</mo><mn>0</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>l</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>96</mn><mtext> </mtext><mi>p</mi><mi>l</mi></mrow></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>

<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mtext>Perubahan</mtext><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>−</mo><msub><mi>L</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>96</mn><mi>p</mi><mi>l</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>p</mi><mi>l</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>0</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>04</mn><mi>p</mi><mi>l</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\text{Perubahan} = L_2 &#8211; L_1 = 0,96pl &#8211; pl = -0,04pl</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></span></p>

Pertanyaan ke <span>22</span> dari <span>50</span> </div>
<h5 style="display: inline-block;"
class="wpProQuiz_header">
<span>22</span>. Pertanyaan </h5>

<span style="font-weight: bold; float: right;">2 poin</span>
<div style="clear: both;"></div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Suatu kelompok belajar yang terdiri dari 10 orang membentuk 2 kelompok berbeda yang anggotanya masing-masing sama banyak. Rata-rata berat badan kelompok pertama 45,8 kg dan rata-rata kelompok kedua 47,6 kg. Karena menginginkan rata-rata berat badan dari dua kelompok tersebut sama maka Ani pada kelompok pertama dan Anton pada kelompok kedua saling bertukar kelompok dan rata-rata berat badannya menjadi sama. Berapa selisih berat badan Ani dan Anton ?</p>
</div>
<ul class="wpProQuiz_questionList" data-question_id="28841"
data-type="single">
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="0">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28841"
value="1"> 9 kg
</label>

</li>

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28841"
value="2"> 6,3 kg </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="2">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28841"
value="3"> 5,2 kg </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="3">

<span style="display:none;"></span>

type="radio"
name="question_144_28841"
value="4"> 4,5 kg </label>

</li>
</ul>

<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_correct">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Benar </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<p data-start="67" data-end="83"><strong data-start="67" data-end="81">Diketahui:</strong></p>
<ul data-start="84" data-end="247">
<li data-start="84" data-end="121">
<p data-start="86" data-end="121">2 kelompok, masing-masing 5 orang</p>
</li>
<li data-start="122" data-end="184">
<p data-start="124" data-end="184">Rata-rata kelompok 1 = 45,8 kg → total = 5 × 45,8 = 229 kg</p>
</li>
<li data-start="185" data-end="247">
<p data-start="187" data-end="247">Rata-rata kelompok 2 = 47,6 kg → total = 5 × 47,6 = 238 kg</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="249" data-end="263"><strong data-start="249" data-end="261">Langkah:</strong></p>
<ul data-start="264" data-end="447">
<li data-start="264" data-end="298">
<p data-start="266" data-end="298">Misal Ani = A kg, Anton = B kg</p>
</li>
<li data-start="299" data-end="378">
<p data-start="301" data-end="378">Setelah bertukar, total berat tiap kelompok sama = (229 + 238)/2 = 233,5 kg</p>
</li>
<li data-start="379" data-end="447">
<p data-start="381" data-end="447">Kelompok 1 setelah pertukaran: 229 – A + B = 233,5 → B – A = 4,5</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="449" data-end="502" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node=""><strong data-start="449" data-end="461">Jawaban:</strong> Selisih berat Ani dan Anton = <strong data-start="492" data-end="502" data-is-last-node="">4,5 kg</strong></p> </div>
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_incorrect">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Salah </span><br>

<ul data-start="84" data-end="247">
<li data-start="84" data-end="121">
<p data-start="86" data-end="121">2 kelompok, masing-masing 5 orang</p>
</li>

</li>
<li data-start="185" data-end="247">
<p data-start="187" data-end="247">Rata-rata kelompok 2 = 47,6 kg → total = 5 × 47,6 = 238 kg</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="249" data-end="263"><strong data-start="249" data-end="261">Langkah:</strong></p>
<ul data-start="264" data-end="447">

<p data-start="266" data-end="298">Misal Ani = A kg, Anton = B kg</p>
</li>
<li data-start="299" data-end="378">
<p data-start="301" data-end="378">Setelah bertukar, total berat tiap kelompok sama = (229 + 238)/2 = 233,5 kg</p>
</li>
<li data-start="379" data-end="447">
<p data-start="381" data-end="447">Kelompok 1 setelah pertukaran: 229 – A + B = 233,5 → B – A = 4,5</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="449" data-end="502" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node=""><strong data-start="449" data-end="461">Jawaban:</strong> Selisih berat Ani dan Anton = <strong data-start="492" data-end="502" data-is-last-node="">4,5 kg</strong></p>

Pertanyaan ke <span>23</span> dari <span>50</span> </div>
<h5 style="display: inline-block;"
class="wpProQuiz_header">
<span>23</span>. Pertanyaan </h5>

<span style="font-weight: bold; float: right;">2 poin</span>
<div style="clear: both;"></div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Dalam sebuah keluarga yang terdiri dari 6 orang anak, dua anaknya berumur x tahun dan 4 tahun. Jika rata-rata umur anak adalah 9 tahun dan umur empat anak lainnya adalah :</p>
<p>X + 1, 1/2X + 2, 2x-3, dan 3/2X + 2,</p>
<p>Maka berapa tahun umur anak tertua ?</p>
</div>
<ul class="wpProQuiz_questionList" data-question_id="28842"
data-type="single">
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="0">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28842"
value="1"> 16 </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="1">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28842"
value="2"> 14 </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="2">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28842"
value="3"> 13 </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="3">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28842"
value="4"> 12 </label>

</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_correct">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Benar </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<p data-start="69" data-end="85"><strong data-start="69" data-end="83">Diketahui:</strong></p>
<ul data-start="86" data-end="239">
<li data-start="86" data-end="151">
<p data-start="88" data-end="151">Jumlah anak = 6, rata-rata umur = 9 → total umur = 6 × 9 = 54</p>
</li>
<li data-start="152" data-end="239">
<p data-start="154" data-end="239">Umur anak-anak: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math></span></span>, 4, <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x+1</annotation></semantics></math></span></span> , <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+ 2</mo><mn>
</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{1}{2}x+2</annotation></semantics></math></span>,2</span><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2x-3</annotation></semantics></math></span></span>, <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{3}{2}x+2</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="241" data-end="255"><strong data-start="241" data-end="253">Langkah:</strong></p>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>54</mn></mrow></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>
<p data-start="332" data-end="462">Gabungkan suku <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math></span> </span>: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>0</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1+1+0,5+2+1,5 = 6x</annotation></semantics></math></span></span><br data-start="376" data-end="379" />Gabungkan konstanta: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">4+1+2-3+2 = 6</annotation></semantics></math></span></span><br data-start="417" data-end="420" />Sehingga: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>54</mn><mtext>  </mtext><mo>⟹</mo><mtext>  </mtext><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">6x + 6 = 54 \implies x = 8</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
<p data-start="464" data-end="507"><strong data-start="464" data-end="478">Langkah 2:</strong> Hitung umur masing-masing:</p>
<ul data-start="508" data-end="541">
<li data-start="508" data-end="541">
<p data-start="510" data-end="541">Anak-anak: 8, 4, 9, 6, 13, 14</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="543" data-end="584" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node=""><strong data-start="543" data-end="555">Jawaban:</strong> Anak tertua = <strong data-start="570" data-end="582">14 tahun</strong></p> </div>
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_incorrect">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Salah </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<p data-start="69" data-end="85"><strong data-start="69" data-end="83">Diketahui:</strong></p>
<ul data-start="86" data-end="239">
<li data-start="86" data-end="151">
<p data-start="88" data-end="151">Jumlah anak = 6, rata-rata umur = 9 → total umur = 6 × 9 = 54</p>
</li>
<li data-start="152" data-end="239">
<p data-start="154" data-end="239">Umur anak-anak: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math></span></span>, 4, <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x+1</annotation></semantics></math></span></span> , <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+ 2</mo><mn>
</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{1}{2}x+2</annotation></semantics></math></span>,2</span><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">2x-3</annotation></semantics></math></span></span>, <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{3}{2}x+2</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="241" data-end="255"><strong data-start="241" data-end="253">Langkah:</strong></p>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>54</mn></mrow></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>
<p data-start="332" data-end="462">Gabungkan suku <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x</annotation></semantics></math></span> </span>: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>0</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1+1+0,5+2+1,5 = 6x</annotation></semantics></math></span></span><br data-start="376" data-end="379" />Gabungkan konstanta: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">4+1+2-3+2 = 6</annotation></semantics></math></span></span><br data-start="417" data-end="420" />Sehingga: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>54</mn><mtext>  </mtext><mo>⟹</mo><mtext>  </mtext><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">6x + 6 = 54 \implies x = 8</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
<p data-start="464" data-end="507"><strong data-start="464" data-end="478">Langkah 2:</strong> Hitung umur masing-masing:</p>
<ul data-start="508" data-end="541">
<li data-start="508" data-end="541">
<p data-start="510" data-end="541">Anak-anak: 8, 4, 9, 6, 13, 14</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="543" data-end="584" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node=""><strong data-start="543" data-end="555">Jawaban:</strong> Anak tertua = <strong data-start="570" data-end="582">14 tahun</strong></p>
</div>
</div>

<h5 style="display: inline-block;"

<span>25</span>. Pertanyaan </h5>

<span style="font-weight: bold; float: right;">2 poin</span>

<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Sebuah tempat air berbentuk tabung berdiameter 40 cm dengan tinggi tabung 150 cm, berisi air dengan tinggi 1 m. Ke dalam tabung dimasukkan 3 bola pada yang masing-masing berjari-jari 10 cm. Besarnya kenaikan tinggi air adalah ….</p>
</div>
<ul class="wpProQuiz_questionList" data-question_id="28844"
data-type="single">
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="0">

<span style="display:none;"></span>

<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28844"

<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28844"

type="radio"

<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_correct">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Benar </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<ul data-start="81" data-end="189">
<li data-start="81" data-end="161">
<p data-start="83" data-end="161">Tabung: diameter = 40 cm → jari-jari <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>20</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r = 20</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord mathnormal">r</span><span class="mrel">=</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">20</span></span></span></span> cm, tinggi air awal = 100 cm</p>
</li>
<li data-start="162" data-end="189">
<p data-start="164" data-end="189">3 bola, jari-jari 10 cm</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="191" data-end="205"><strong data-start="191" data-end="203">Langkah:</strong></p>
<ol data-start="206" data-end="225">
<li data-start="206" data-end="225">
<p data-start="209" data-end="225">Volume 3 bola:</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mi>V</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>×</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mi>π</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>10</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4000</mn><mi>π</mi><mtext> </mtext><mtext>cm³</mtext></mrow></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>
<ol start="2" data-start="293" data-end="318">
<li data-start="293" data-end="318">
<p data-start="296" data-end="318">Kenaikan tinggi air:</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mi>π</mi><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>V</mi><mtext>  </mtext><mo>⟹</mo><mtext>  </mtext><mi>π</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mn>20</mn><mn>2</mn></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4000</mn><mi>π</mi><mtext>  </mtext><mo>⟹</mo><mtext>  </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn><mtext> cm</mtext></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi r^2 \Delta h = V \implies \pi (20^2) \Delta h = 4000\pi \implies \Delta h = 10 \text{ cm}</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></span></p> </div>
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_incorrect">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Salah </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<ul data-start="81" data-end="189">
<li data-start="81" data-end="161">
<p data-start="83" data-end="161">Tabung: diameter = 40 cm → jari-jari <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>20</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">r = 20</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord mathnormal">r</span><span class="mrel">=</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">20</span></span></span></span> cm, tinggi air awal = 100 cm</p>
</li>
<li data-start="162" data-end="189">
<p data-start="164" data-end="189">3 bola, jari-jari 10 cm</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="191" data-end="205"><strong data-start="191" data-end="203">Langkah:</strong></p>
<ol data-start="206" data-end="225">
<li data-start="206" data-end="225">
<p data-start="209" data-end="225">Volume 3 bola:</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mi>V</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>×</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><mn>3</mn></mfrac><mi>π</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>10</mn><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4000</mn><mi>π</mi><mtext> </mtext><mtext>cm³</mtext></mrow></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>
<ol start="2" data-start="293" data-end="318">
<li data-start="293" data-end="318">
<p data-start="296" data-end="318">Kenaikan tinggi air:</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mi>π</mi><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>V</mi><mtext>  </mtext><mo>⟹</mo><mtext>  </mtext><mi>π</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mn>20</mn><mn>2</mn></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4000</mn><mi>π</mi><mtext>  </mtext><mo>⟹</mo><mtext>  </mtext><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn><mtext> cm</mtext></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\pi r^2 \Delta h = V \implies \pi (20^2) \Delta h = 4000\pi \implies \Delta h = 10 \text{ cm}</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>

class="wpProQuiz_question_page" >
Pertanyaan ke <span>26</span> dari <span>50</span> </div>
<h5 style="display: inline-block;"
class="wpProQuiz_header">
<span>26</span>. Pertanyaan </h5>

<span style="font-weight: bold; float: right;">2 poin</span>
<div style="clear: both;"></div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Sebuah mobil dengan kapasitas tanki penuh bensin dilakukan untuk melakukan perjalanan dari kota P ke kota Q dengan kecepatan rata-rata 52 km/jam membutuhkan waktu perjalanan 3,5 jam (dengan bensin tersisa pada tanki sebanyak 2/3 bagian). Jika bensin pada tanki diisi ½ bagian, kemudia digunakan untuk melakukan perjalanan dari kota P ke Q dengan kecepatan yang sama, berapa waktu yang dibutuhkan untuk sampai tujuan ?</p>
</div>
<ul class="wpProQuiz_questionList" data-question_id="28845"
data-type="single">
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="0">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28845"
value="1"> 3,5 jam </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="1">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28845"
value="2"> 3 jam </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="2">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28845"
value="3"> 2 jam </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="3">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28845"
value="4"> 2,5 jam </label>

</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_correct">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Benar </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<p>dik :</p>
<ul data-start="86" data-end="318">
<li data-start="86" data-end="117">
<p data-start="88" data-end="117">Kecepatan mobil = 52 km/jam</p>
</li>
<li data-start="118" data-end="156">
<p data-start="120" data-end="156">Waktu perjalanan pertama = 3,5 jam</p>
</li>
<li data-start="157" data-end="220">
<p data-start="159" data-end="220">Sisa bensin = 2/3 tanki → artinya yang terpakai = 1/3 tanki</p>
</li>
<li data-start="221" data-end="318">
<p data-start="223" data-end="318">Pertanyaan: jika bensin diisi 1/2 tanki, berapa waktu tempuh ke kota Q dengan kecepatan sama?</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="325" data-end="360"><strong data-start="325" data-end="358">Langkah 1: Hitung jarak P → Q</strong></p>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mtext>Jarak</mtext><mo>=</mo><mtext>Kecepatan</mtext><mo>×</mo><mtext>Waktu</mtext><mo>=</mo><mn>52</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>3</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>182</mn><mtext> km</mtext></mrow></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>
<p data-start="460" data-end="506"><strong data-start="460" data-end="504">Langkah 2: Tentukan konsumsi bahan bakar</strong></p>
<ul data-start="507" data-end="601">
<li data-start="507" data-end="538">
<p data-start="509" data-end="538">1/3 tanki → menempuh 182 km</p>
</li>
<li data-start="539" data-end="601">
<p data-start="541" data-end="601">Maka, 1 tanki → menempuh <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>182</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>546</mn><mtext> km</mtext></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">182 \times 3 = 546 \text{ km}</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="608" data-end="654"><strong data-start="608" data-end="652">Langkah 3: Waktu tempuh dengan 1/2 tanki</strong></p>
<ul data-start="655" data-end="898">
<li data-start="655" data-end="729">
<p data-start="657" data-end="729">1/2 tanki → jarak tempuh = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>546</mn><mo>×</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>273</mn><mtext> km</mtext></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">546 \times \frac{1}{2} = 273 \text{ km}</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="730" data-end="794">
<p data-start="732" data-end="794">Tapi jarak kota P → Q = 182 km &lt; 273 km → cukup untuk sampai</p>
</li>
<li data-start="795" data-end="898">
<p data-start="797" data-end="898">Waktu tempuh = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mtext>Jarak</mtext><mtext>Kecepatan</mtext></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>182</mn><mn>52</mn></mfrac><mo>≈</mo><mn>3</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>5</mn><mtext> jam</mtext></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\text{Jarak}}{\text{Kecepatan}} = \frac{182}{52} \approx 3,5 \text{ jam}</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
</li>
</ul> </div>
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_incorrect">

<ul data-start="86" data-end="318">

<p data-start="88" data-end="117">Kecepatan mobil = 52 km/jam</p>
</li>
<li data-start="118" data-end="156">
<p data-start="120" data-end="156">Waktu perjalanan pertama = 3,5 jam</p>
</li>
<li data-start="157" data-end="220">
<p data-start="159" data-end="220">Sisa bensin = 2/3 tanki → artinya yang terpakai = 1/3 tanki</p>
</li>
<li data-start="221" data-end="318">
<p data-start="223" data-end="318">Pertanyaan: jika bensin diisi 1/2 tanki, berapa waktu tempuh ke kota Q dengan kecepatan sama?</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="325" data-end="360"><strong data-start="325" data-end="358">Langkah 1: Hitung jarak P → Q</strong></p>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mtext>Jarak</mtext><mo>=</mo><mtext>Kecepatan</mtext><mo>×</mo><mtext>Waktu</mtext><mo>=</mo><mn>52</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>3</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>182</mn><mtext> km</mtext></mrow></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>
<p data-start="460" data-end="506"><strong data-start="460" data-end="504">Langkah 2: Tentukan konsumsi bahan bakar</strong></p>

<p data-start="509" data-end="538">1/3 tanki → menempuh 182 km</p>
</li>
<li data-start="539" data-end="601">
<p data-start="541" data-end="601">Maka, 1 tanki → menempuh <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>182</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>546</mn><mtext> km</mtext></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">182 \times 3 = 546 \text{ km}</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="608" data-end="654"><strong data-start="608" data-end="652">Langkah 3: Waktu tempuh dengan 1/2 tanki</strong></p>
<ul data-start="655" data-end="898">
<li data-start="655" data-end="729">
<p data-start="657" data-end="729">1/2 tanki → jarak tempuh = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>546</mn><mo>×</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>273</mn><mtext> km</mtext></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">546 \times \frac{1}{2} = 273 \text{ km}</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="730" data-end="794">
<p data-start="732" data-end="794">Tapi jarak kota P → Q = 182 km &lt; 273 km → cukup untuk sampai</p>
</li>
<li data-start="795" data-end="898">
<p data-start="797" data-end="898">Waktu tempuh = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mtext>Jarak</mtext><mtext>Kecepatan</mtext></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>182</mn><mn>52</mn></mfrac><mo>≈</mo><mn>3</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>5</mn><mtext> jam</mtext></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{\text{Jarak}}{\text{Kecepatan}} = \frac{182}{52} \approx 3,5 \text{ jam}</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
</li>
</ul>

<p>Seseorang ingin mengiklankan mobilnya melalui surat kabar dalam 3 bari. Berapa hari ia bisa memasang iklan di surat kabar tersebut jika ia membayar Rp.360.000,00 ?</p>

<li data-start="35" data-end="208">
<p data-start="37" data-end="45">Hari 1: Rp30.000/baris → 3×30.000 = 90.000</p>

<li data-start="35" data-end="208">Hari 2–4: Rp20.000/baris → 3×20.000 = 60.000/hari</li>

<li data-start="209" data-end="233">

<ol data-start="250" data-end="427">

<li data-start="134" data-end="185">langkah :</li>

<ol data-start="210" data-end="552">
<li data-start="210" data-end="275">
<p data-start="213" data-end="275">Jumlah lima bilangan: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>5</mn><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>10</mn><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>75</mn><mtext>  </mtext><mo>⟹</mo><mtext>  </mtext><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>15</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">5a + 10d = 75 \implies a + 2d = 15</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />

<li data-start="493" data-end="552">

</li>
<li data-start="333" data-end="413">
<p data-start="336" data-end="413">Substitusi <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>4</mn><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>15</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">4d = 2(15-a)</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord">4</span><span class="mord mathnormal">d</span><span class="mrel">=</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">2</span><span class="mopen">(</span><span class="mord">15</span><span class="mbin">−</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord mathnormal">a</span><span class="mclose">)</span></span></span></span>: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>30</mn><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>161</mn><mtext>  </mtext><mo>⟹</mo><mtext>  </mtext><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>30</mn><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>161</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a(30-a) = 161 \implies a^2 &#8211; 30a + 161 = 0</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="414" data-end="492">
<p data-start="417" data-end="492">Selesaikan kuadrat: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">a = 7</annotation></semantics></math></span></span>  atau <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo></mrow></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord">23</span></span></span></span> → <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d = 4</annotation></semantics></math></span></span> atau <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">d = -4</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="493" data-end="552">
<p data-start="496" data-end="552">Selisih bilangan terbesar dan terkecil = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">∣</mi><mn>4</mn><mi>d</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">∣</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>16</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">|4d| = 16</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>

<h5 style="display: inline-block;"

<span>29</span>. Pertanyaan </h5>

<div style="clear: both;"></div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Sebuah kelas memiliki 12 siswa. Rata-rata tinggi 5 siswa pertama adalah 150 cm, sedangkan rata-rata tinggi 7 siswa lainnya adalah 160 cm. Jika seluruh siswa digabungkan, berapakah rata-rata tinggi seluruh siswa &#8230;</p>
</div>

type="radio"
name="question_144_28848"
value="2"> 156 cm </label>

<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="2">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28848"
value="3"> 157 cm </label>

value="5"> 159 cm </label>

</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_correct">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Benar </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<ul>
<li data-start="442" data-end="504">
<p data-start="445" data-end="504">Jumlah tinggi 5 siswa pertama = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>150</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>750</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">5 \times 150 = 750</annotation></semantics></math></span>cm</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="505" data-end="568">
<p data-start="508" data-end="568">Jumlah tinggi 7 siswa lainnya = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>7</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>160</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>1120</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">7 \times 160 = 1120</annotation></semantics></math></span>cm</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="569" data-end="621">
<p data-start="572" data-end="621">Jumlah seluruh siswa = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>750</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1120</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>1870</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">750 + 1120 = 1870</annotation></semantics></math></span>cm</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="622" data-end="690">
<p data-start="625" data-end="690">Rata-rata seluruh siswa = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>1870</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">/</mi><mn>12</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>155</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>83</mn><mo>≈</mo><mn>156</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1870 / 12 = 155,83 \approx 156</annotation></semantics></math></span></span> cm</p>
</li>
</ul> </div>
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_incorrect">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Salah </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<ul>
<li data-start="442" data-end="504">
<p data-start="445" data-end="504">Jumlah tinggi 5 siswa pertama = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>150</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>750</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">5 \times 150 = 750</annotation></semantics></math></span>cm</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="505" data-end="568">
<p data-start="508" data-end="568">Jumlah tinggi 7 siswa lainnya = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>7</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>160</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>1120</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">7 \times 160 = 1120</annotation></semantics></math></span>cm</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="569" data-end="621">
<p data-start="572" data-end="621">Jumlah seluruh siswa = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>750</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1120</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>1870</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">750 + 1120 = 1870</annotation></semantics></math></span>cm</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="622" data-end="690">
<p data-start="625" data-end="690">Rata-rata seluruh siswa = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>1870</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">/</mi><mn>12</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>155</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>83</mn><mo>≈</mo><mn>156</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">1870 / 12 = 155,83 \approx 156</annotation></semantics></math></span></span> cm</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Sebuah kelas memiliki rata-rata nilai 5,2 dan median 6. Karena data yang diperoleh tidak memuaskan, seluruh data diubah dengan cara setiap data dikali 5 dan hasilnya dibagi 5. Nilai rata-rata dan median setelah data diubah adalah ….</p>

<p data-start="168" data-end="190"><strong data-start="168" data-end="188">Langkah-langkah:</strong></p>

<p data-start="194" data-end="247">Perubahan data = ×5 ÷5 = tetap sama (tidak berubah)</p>

<li data-start="248" data-end="280">

<h5 style="display: inline-block;"

<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Pembangun sebuah gedung direncanakan akan selesai pada waktu 22 hari oleh 24 orang pekerja. Setelah dikerjakan selama 10 hari, pekerjaan dihentikan 40 hari karena ada sesuatu hal. Jika kemampuan bekerja setiap orang sama dan agar pembangunan selesai sesuai tepat waktu, maka banyak pekerja tambahan yang dibutuhkan adalah …</p>
</div>
<ul class="wpProQuiz_questionList" data-question_id="28850"
data-type="single">
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="0">

<span style="display:none;"></span>

<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="1">

<span style="display:none;"></span>

<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28850"
value="2"> 8 orang </label>

</li>
<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="2">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"

value="3"> 10 orang </label>

<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="3">

<span style="display:none;"></span>
<label>
<input class="wpProQuiz_questionInput"
type="radio"
name="question_144_28850"
value="4"> 12 orang </label>

</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_response" style="display: none;">
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_correct">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Benar </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<p>dik :</p>
<ul data-start="75" data-end="216">
<li data-start="75" data-end="119">
<p data-start="77" data-end="119">Pekerjaan direncanakan selesai = 22 hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="120" data-end="142">
<p data-start="122" data-end="142">Pekerja = 24 orang</p>
</li>
<li data-start="143" data-end="189">
<p data-start="145" data-end="189">Setelah 10 hari bekerja, dihentikan 4 hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="190" data-end="216">
<p data-start="192" data-end="216">Kemampuan pekerja sama</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="218" data-end="240"><strong data-start="218" data-end="238">Langkah-langkah:</strong></p>
<ol data-start="241" data-end="727">
<li data-start="241" data-end="289">
<p data-start="244" data-end="289">Total hari efektif tanpa tambahan = 22 hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="290" data-end="371">
<p data-start="293" data-end="371">Pekerjaan selama 10 hari oleh 24 orang = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>10</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>24</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>240</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">10 \times 24 = 240</annotation></semantics></math></span></span> satuan kerja</p>
</li>
<li data-start="372" data-end="447">
<p data-start="375" data-end="447">Sisa pekerjaan = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>22</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>24</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>240</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>528</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>240</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>288</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">22 \times 24 &#8211; 240 = 528 &#8211; 240 = 288</annotation></semantics></math></span></span> satuan kerja</p>
</li>
<li data-start="448" data-end="514">
<p data-start="451" data-end="514">Sisa waktu setelah berhenti 4 hari = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>22</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>10</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">22 &#8211; 10 &#8211; 4 = 8</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord">22</span><span class="mbin">−</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">10</span><span class="mbin">−</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">4</span><span class="mrel">=</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">8</span></span></span></span> hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="515" data-end="727">
<p data-start="518" data-end="553">Pekerja tambahan yang dibutuhkan:</p>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mtext>Jumlah pekerja</mtext><mo>×</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>288</mn><mtext>  </mtext><mo>⟹</mo><mtext>  </mtext><mtext>Jumlah pekerja</mtext><mo>=</mo><mn>288</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">/</mi><mn>8</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>36</mn></mrow></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>
<p data-start="657" data-end="727">Karena awalnya ada 24 pekerja, pekerja tambahan = 36 − 24 = 12 orang</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="729" data-end="765"> </div>
<div style="display: none;" class="wpProQuiz_incorrect">
<span class="wpProQuiz_respone_span">
Salah </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<p>dik :</p>
<ul data-start="75" data-end="216">
<li data-start="75" data-end="119">
<p data-start="77" data-end="119">Pekerjaan direncanakan selesai = 22 hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="120" data-end="142">
<p data-start="122" data-end="142">Pekerja = 24 orang</p>
</li>
<li data-start="143" data-end="189">
<p data-start="145" data-end="189">Setelah 10 hari bekerja, dihentikan 4 hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="190" data-end="216">
<p data-start="192" data-end="216">Kemampuan pekerja sama</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="218" data-end="240"><strong data-start="218" data-end="238">Langkah-langkah:</strong></p>
<ol data-start="241" data-end="727">
<li data-start="241" data-end="289">
<p data-start="244" data-end="289">Total hari efektif tanpa tambahan = 22 hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="290" data-end="371">
<p data-start="293" data-end="371">Pekerjaan selama 10 hari oleh 24 orang = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>10</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>24</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>240</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">10 \times 24 = 240</annotation></semantics></math></span></span> satuan kerja</p>
</li>
<li data-start="372" data-end="447">
<p data-start="375" data-end="447">Sisa pekerjaan = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>22</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>24</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>240</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>528</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>240</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>288</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">22 \times 24 &#8211; 240 = 528 &#8211; 240 = 288</annotation></semantics></math></span></span> satuan kerja</p>
</li>
<li data-start="448" data-end="514">
<p data-start="451" data-end="514">Sisa waktu setelah berhenti 4 hari = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>22</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>10</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">22 &#8211; 10 &#8211; 4 = 8</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord">22</span><span class="mbin">−</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">10</span><span class="mbin">−</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">4</span><span class="mrel">=</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">8</span></span></span></span> hari</p>
</li>
<li data-start="515" data-end="727">
<p data-start="518" data-end="553">Pekerja tambahan yang dibutuhkan:</p>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mtext>Jumlah pekerja</mtext><mo>×</mo><mn>8</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>288</mn><mtext>  </mtext><mo>⟹</mo><mtext>  </mtext><mtext>Jumlah pekerja</mtext><mo>=</mo><mn>288</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">/</mi><mn>8</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>36</mn></mrow></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>
<p data-start="657" data-end="727">Karena awalnya ada 24 pekerja, pekerja tambahan = 36 − 24 = 12 orang</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="729" data-end="765">
</div>
</div>

<ol data-start="129" data-end="266">

<p data-start="132" data-end="266">Jumlah bilangan = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>101</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>×</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mtext>bilangan terbesar</mtext><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{101}{2} \times (3n + \text{bilangan terbesar})</annotation></semantics></math></span></span><br data-start="206" data-end="209" />Bilangan terbesar = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>100</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>300</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3n + 3 \times 100 = 3n + 300</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></p>

<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mn>18.180</mn><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>101</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>×</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>300</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>101</mn><mo>×</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>150</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>
<ol start="2" data-start="346" data-end="362">

<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>150</mn><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>18.180</mn><mn>101</mn></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>180</mn><mtext>  </mtext><mo>⟹</mo><mtext>  </mtext><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>30</mn><mtext>  </mtext><mo>⟹</mo><mtext>  </mtext><mi>n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn></mrow></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>

<ol data-start="129" data-end="266">

<p data-start="132" data-end="266">Jumlah bilangan = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mn>101</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>×</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mtext>bilangan terbesar</mtext><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{101}{2} \times (3n + \text{bilangan terbesar})</annotation></semantics></math></span></span><br data-start="206" data-end="209" />Bilangan terbesar = <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>×</mo><mn>100</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>300</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">3n + 3 \times 100 = 3n + 300</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></p>

<h5 style="display: inline-block;"

<span>33</span>. Pertanyaan </h5>

<div style="clear: both;"></div>
<div class="wpProQuiz_question" style="margin: 10px 0 0 0;">
<div class="wpProQuiz_question_text">
<p>Perbandingan jumlah kelereng Amat dengan Cemen adalah 7 : 5, sedangkan perbandingan jumlah kelereng Bagio dan Amat adalah 3 : 4. Jika selisih jumlah kelereng Amat dan Cemen adalah 16 buah maka banyaknya kelereng Bagio adalah ….</p>
</div>

<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="1">

<span style="display:none;"></span>

type="radio"

<li class="wpProQuiz_questionListItem" data-pos="2">

Benar </span><br>
<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<p>dik:</p>
<ul data-start="17" data-end="96">
<li data-start="17" data-end="41">
<p data-start="19" data-end="41">Amat : Cemen = 7 : 5</p>
</li>
<li data-start="42" data-end="66">
<p data-start="44" data-end="66">Bagio : Amat = 3 : 4</p>
</li>
<li data-start="67" data-end="96">
<p data-start="69" data-end="96">Selisih Amat – Cemen = 16</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="98" data-end="120"><strong data-start="98" data-end="118">Langkah:</strong></p>
<ol data-start="121" data-end="256">
<li data-start="121" data-end="186">
<p data-start="124" data-end="186">Misal Amat = 7x, Cemen = 5x → 7x – 5x = 16 → 2x = 16 → x = 8</p>
</li>
<li data-start="187" data-end="206">
<p data-start="190" data-end="206">Amat = 7x = 56</p>
</li>
<li data-start="207" data-end="256">
<p data-start="210" data-end="256">Bagio : Amat = 3 : 4 → Bagio = 3/4 × 56 = 42</p>
</li>
</ol> </div>

</li>
<li data-start="42" data-end="66">
<p data-start="44" data-end="66">Bagio : Amat = 3 : 4</p>
</li>
<li data-start="67" data-end="96">
<p data-start="69" data-end="96">Selisih Amat – Cemen = 16</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="98" data-end="120"><strong data-start="98" data-end="118">Langkah:</strong></p>
<ol data-start="121" data-end="256">

</li>

</li>

<li data-start="102" data-end="137">

<p>Pembahasan :</p>
<p data-start="0" data-end="16"><strong data-start="0" data-end="14">Diketahui:</strong></p>
<ul data-start="17" data-end="83">

<p data-start="19" data-end="46">Jumlah kelereng putih = 6</p>
