</ul>
<p data-start="85" data-end="171"><strong data-start="85" data-end="105">Langkah:</strong><br data-start="105" data-end="108" />Banyak cara memilih 3 kelereng putih dari 6 adalah kombinasi:</p>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="false">!</mo></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">!</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">!</mo></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>6</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>20</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">C(6,3) = \frac{6!}{3!(6-3)!} = \frac{6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 20</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></span></p> </div>

</li>

</li>

<p data-start="85" data-end="171"><strong data-start="85" data-end="105">Langkah:</strong><br data-start="105" data-end="108" />Banyak cara memilih 3 kelereng putih dari 6 adalah kombinasi:</p>
<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>6</mn><mo stretchy="false">!</mo></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">!</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">!</mo></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>6</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>20</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">C(6,3) = \frac{6!}{3!(6-3)!} = \frac{6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 20</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></span></p>

<ul data-start="17" data-end="124">

</li>
<li data-start="72" data-end="124">

<p data-start="126" data-end="171"><strong data-start="126" data-end="146">Langkah:</strong><br data-start="146" data-end="149" />Banyak cara memilih:</p>
<ol data-start="173" data-end="385">
<li data-start="173" data-end="247">
<p data-start="176" data-end="247">Sapi: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>6</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>20</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">C(6,3) = \frac{6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 20</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></p>
</li>

</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="308" data-end="385">
<p data-start="311" data-end="385">Kambing: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>8</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>8</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>56</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">C(8,5) = \frac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 56</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
</li>
</ol>

<li data-start="72" data-end="124">
<p data-start="74" data-end="124">Pedagang menyediakan: 6 sapi, 6 domba, 8 kambing</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="126" data-end="171"><strong data-start="126" data-end="146">Langkah:</strong><br data-start="146" data-end="149" />Banyak cara memilih:</p>

<li data-start="173" data-end="247">
<p data-start="176" data-end="247">Sapi: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>6</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>6</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>20</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">C(6,3) = \frac{6 \cdot 5 \cdot 4}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 20</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="173" data-end="247">

</span></p>
</li>
<li data-start="308" data-end="385">
<p data-start="311" data-end="385">Kambing: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>8</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mn>5</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>8</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>7</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>56</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">C(8,5) = \frac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 56</annotation></semantics></math></span><br />
</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p data-start="387" data-end="443">Total banyak cara: <span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mn>20</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>15</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mn>56</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>16.800</mn></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">20 \cdot 15 \cdot 56 = 16.800</annotation></semantics></math></span><span class="katex-html" aria-hidden="true"><span class="base"><span class="mord">20</span><span class="mbin">⋅</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">15</span><span class="mbin">⋅</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">56</span><span class="mrel">=</span></span><span class="base"><span class="mord">16.800</span></span></span></span></p>

<p><span class="katex-display"><span class="katex"><span class="katex-mathml"><math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><mo separator="true">,</mo><mspace width="1em"></mspace><msub><mi>p</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mtext> (A)</mtext></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">n = 8, \quad p_1 = 3 \text{ (A)}</annotation></semantics></math></span></span></span>Hitung:</p>

<script>
(function() {
function loadUserHistory() {
const data = new FormData();
data.append('action', 'get_user_quiz_history');
data.append('quiz_id', 144);

fetch('https://app.suksescat.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php', {
method: 'POST',
body: data
})
.then(response => response.json())
.then(result => {
const content = document.getElementById('quiz-user-history-content');
if (result.success) {
content.innerHTML = result.data;
} else {
content.innerHTML = '<p>Gagal memuat data atau data belum tersedia.</p>';
}
})
.catch(err => console.error('Error fetching history:', err));
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', loadUserHistory);
// Refresh otomatis setiap 10 detik agar terlihat real-time saat user selesai mengerjakan
setInterval(loadUserHistory, 10000);
})();
</script>

<script>
const lazyloadRunObserver = () => {
const lazyloadBackgrounds = document.querySelectorAll( `.e-con.e-parent:not(.e-lazyloaded)` );
const lazyloadBackgroundObserver = new IntersectionObserver( ( entries ) => {
entries.forEach( ( entry ) => {
if ( entry.isIntersecting ) {
let lazyloadBackground = entry.target;
if( lazyloadBackground ) {
lazyloadBackground.classList.add( 'e-lazyloaded' );
}
lazyloadBackgroundObserver.unobserve( entry.target );
}
});
}, { rootMargin: '200px 0px 200px 0px' } );
lazyloadBackgrounds.forEach( ( lazyloadBackground ) => {
lazyloadBackgroundObserver.observe( lazyloadBackground );
} );
};
const events = [
'DOMContentLoaded',
'elementor/lazyload/observe',
];
events.forEach( ( event ) => {
document.addEventListener( event, lazyloadRunObserver );
} );
</script>
